header: Amazon OpenSearch Service ML connectors for third-party platforms
content:
platforms
In this tutorial, we cover how to create a connector from OpenSearch Service to Cohere. For more
information about connectors, see Supported connectors.
When you use an Amazon OpenSearch Service machine learning (ML) connector with an external
remote model, you need to store your speciﬁc authorization credentials in AWS Secrets Manager.
This could be an API key, or a username and password combination. This means you also need to
create an IAM role that allows OpenSearch Service access to read from Secrets Manager.
